scope: Current 449 interface-inventory entries and corresponding bounded-flow artifacts; independent graph/bytes/metadata/codegen consistency checks, not state-machine semantic recovery.

findings.finding: The producer distinguishes raw branch paths, assumed-return calls, indirect unknown targets, traps and unmodeled branch/system exits. No state meaning or exception/cancellation coverage is implied.
The current census exactly preserves 445 mapped entries and four null codegen slots; no bytes are fabricated for the four null records.

The producer now rejects an inventory owner/TypeDef mismatch or forged NULL before deciding whether to extract native bytes. Current449 entries were rechecked through this new guard; previous894 artifact digests remain identical.

limits: Interface discovery completeness remains the responsibility of the inventory investigation; this review checks its449 current entries, not every inherited/manual/reflection-generated machine or callbacks/events.

Conservative system handling also treats otherwise ordinary hints/system instructions (for example NOP/PACIASP/DMB when present) as unknown exits. Therefore local reachable counts can be underapproximations relative to actual execution; the report never labels full bodies or semantics complete.
BL/BLR fallthrough assumes normal return. Nonreturning callees, exceptions, jump-table/indirect branch targets, memory effects and asynchronous engine scheduling remain unknown.
No449 LLVM decompilations or Unity executions performed; no repeat of the already-green five unit tests.

The new guards validate structural owner/type/entry identity and pointers; inventory discovery completeness, scope-disposition annotations and state-machine semantics remain outside this producer. Extra descriptive inventory method labels are preserved rather than treated as semantic evidence.

delta_review.changes: validate_entry checks original TypeDef/name/token/game image range, raw MethodDef owner/name/token/arity, module RID bound and actual codegen pointer before NULL/address extraction decision. It is called for every inventory entry.
delta_review.result: Prior ownership/forged-NULL guard improvement is resolved; all449 current entries pass. The five original graph tests are supplemented by three entry-identity tests in the reviewed source. This review did not rerun the already-green unit suite.
